note: Legacy Fabric networking channel API (1.20.1) onto 1.21.1 custom payloads. Old mods call ClientPlayNetworking.registerGlobalReceiver(Identifier, PlayChannelHandler) and ServerPlayNetworking.send(player, Identifier, PacketByteBuf); both signatures no longer exist. Applied to AppleSkin 2.5.2 and FallingTree 4.3.4, whose client init and server join crashed with NoClassDefFoundError/NoSuchMethodError (runs/p88-mod-expansion/).

methodRedirects.evidence: AppleSkin squeek.appleskin.network.ClientSyncHandler.init and FallingTree fr.rakambda.fallingtree.fabric.client.network.FabricClientPacketHandler.registerClient call the 1.20.1 two-argument registerGlobalReceiver with an anonymous PlayChannelHandler; on 1.21.1 the mod crashed with NoClassDefFoundError ClientPlayNetworking$PlayChannelHandler (runs/p88-mod-expansion/EXPANSION-REPORT.md). The bridge registers a raw payload type and invokes the legacy handler's receive(client, networkHandler, buf, sender).
ShulkerBoxTooltip ClientNetworkingImpl uses the non-global registerReceiver(Identifier, PlayChannelHandler); the same shim/registration bridge applies.
ShulkerBoxTooltip calls unregisterReceiver(Identifier) and immediately pops the result, so an Object-returning bridge is verifier-safe.

FallingTree FabricServerPacketHandler.onPlayerConnected calls the 1.20.1 ServerPlayNetworking.send(ServerPlayer, Identifier, PacketByteBuf); a client joining the dedicated server crashed with NoSuchMethodError on that call (runs/p88-mod-expansion/EXPANSION-REPORT.md). The bridge wraps the bytes into a registered S2C raw payload.

ShulkerBoxTooltip ServerNetworkingImpl.registerC2SReceiver uses the 1.20.1 three-argument registerReceiver(ServerPlayNetworkHandler, Identifier, PlayChannelHandler); the integrated server crashed with NoClassDefFoundError ServerPlayNetworking$PlayChannelHandler.
Same class; the unregister result is immediately popped.

ShulkerBoxTooltip's handshake writes NBT with the 1.20.1 writeNbt(NbtCompound) descriptor; 1.21.1 keeps method_10794 but widens it to NbtElement, so the old call throws NoSuchMethodError (runs/p96-combined-smoke/).

constructorRedirects.evidence: AppleSkin squeek.appleskin.network.SyncHandler.makeSyncPacket still builds the 1.20.1 CustomPayloadC2SPacket(Identifier, PacketByteBuf); after the receiver bridge let the mod initialize, the client crashed with NoSuchMethodError 'void class_2658.<init>(class_2960, class_2540)'. The factory returns a 1.21.1 C2S packet wrapping the same bytes.
ShulkerBoxTooltip crashed on join with 'NoSuchMethodError void class_2817.<init>(class_2960, class_2540)'; 1.21.1 keeps only the payload constructor.
